worldcombat.skill.growth.summary: Grow and raise Attack and Special Attack together; sunlight doubles the boosts as green rings and leaves spread outward.
worldcombat.skill.growth.use.0: Open a fight by growing once to pad both offences
worldcombat.skill.growth.description.0: Grow: Attack +%1$s stages and Sp. Atk +%2$s stages; in sunlight each gains one more.
worldcombat.skill.growth.description.1: The green ring spreads to %1$s blocks and releases about %2$s leaves.
worldcombat.skill.growth.description.2: The growth window lasts about %1$s; telegraph %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.growth.timing: The telegraph can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.growth.preference.ai.m: Consider growing when a threat is within this distance; larger commits earlier.
worldcombat.skill.growth.preference.ai.w: On: in sunlight the companion grows ahead of the shared order (each offence gains an extra stage). Off: distance only, no waiting for sun.
worldcombat.skill.growth.preference.ai.s: On: skip growth outside sunlight and save it for a sunny moment. Off: grow in shade too (one stage less each).
